description: Find a suitable image for a listing or store product from our search engine when the user cannot give you a public photo URL (chat attachments are not public). Returns verified https image URLs; pass the chosen one in `images` of publish_listing / add_store_product. These are ILLUSTRATIVE images (not the seller's own item): the listing is published with the note «صورة توضيحية» and without our watermark — tell the user, and that they can replace it with a real photo at https://mosaiden.com/profile/listings. Classified-ad and social sites are excluded (their photos are other people's items). ابحث عن صورة مناسبة للإعلان أو المنتج من محرّك بحثنا حين لا يملك المستخدم رابطاً عامّاً لصورته: تُنشر بعلامة «صورة توضيحية»، ويستبدلها بصورته الحقيقية متى شاء.
